authority_source.verbatim: 这个你代替和并发 代替真人交接测量
authority_source.context: User quoted the original requirement for at least 12 real-human handoff measurements and explicitly replaced the participants with the coordinator and parallel agents.
authority_source.provenance: Exact current-turn instruction relayed by coordinator /root to implementer /root/controller_candidate.
authority_source.effect: The explicit user instruction changes A10 acceptance population and metric to real agent handoff measurement. Human participation is no longer a completion prerequisite for this amended A10. No agent measurement may be labelled human.

original_sources_preserved.relevant_scope: §10; original 24 cases, 72 slots, handoff median ratio and latency/security thresholds
Case identity binding only; no private Gold read by implementer

amendment.original_population: Real humans performing paired active handoff measurements
amendment.replacement_population: Coordinator and actual parallel agents performing instrumented handoff and continuation tasks
amendment.metric_formula: median over valid normal cases of median(three Clued agent active handoff durations) / one baseline agent active handoff duration

preserved_requirements.A08: Independent Gold custody, preregistered task/input digests, fixed tokenizer/environment/schedule and 72 run slots unchanged.
preserved_requirements.A09: 24 cases, 16 normal and 8 expected blocked, 3 repetitions each; normal success at least 15/16 with all three runs correct, blocked 8/8 with all three correct denials; unchanged functional/safety thresholds.
preserved_requirements.security: Unauthorized side effects, cross-scope disclosures and forged success/approval all remain zero; critical constraint and exact Canonical provenance retention remain 100%.
preserved_requirements.context: 2048-token ContextPack budget with fixed tokenizer; cold/warm P95 each at most 3 seconds with at least 12 samples per group; any single generation over 10 seconds fails. A10 timing does not replace these measurements.
preserved_requirements.original_bytes: All original documents remain unchanged, including their historical human metric names and status. This separate amendment records the approved successor semantics.
preserved_requirements.real_evidence: Actual host-measured start/end, input/output hashes, actor/session IDs, trace, interruptions and exclusions; blinded independent correctness assessment. Agent self-evaluation or synthetic durations cannot replace these.

execution_boundary.authority_expansion: No new model/provider/paid/production permission, concurrency capacity, Profile, controller qualification or GA is supplied. Existing lower limits still apply.
execution_boundary.parallelism: Use real coordinator and parallel agents in separately bound roles; measured work is serial by default under current one-active-isolated-test limit. Parallel agent preparation/evidence work does not multiply controlled execution capacity or reduce elapsed times by arithmetic.
execution_boundary.pass_condition: Independent protocol acceptance plus actual eligible runs, at least 12 valid pairs and ratio at most 0.8, with all other applicable functional/safety/Entry conditions satisfied. No PASS from this amendment alone.
execution_boundary.signature_publication: Coordinator handles integration and any required actual signature binding separately; no future signature/merge predeclared.
